component-o.description-s: 150 mA Low-Noise LDO Regulator, 2.8V Fixed Output

cfgpins-ao.3c: EN active high; open = shutdown (p2): tied to IN, the datasheet's always-on connection (p8: 'If the enable/shutdown feature is not required, connect EN (pin 3) to IN'); a sequenced design drives it instead

specs-o.en_note-s: no internal pull: EN open = shutdown (p2); IIL 0.01 uA

en_source-o.table-s: ENABLE Input: VIL 0.4 V at 25 C, 0.18 V over -40..125 C (regulator shutdown); VIH 2.0 V min (regulator enabled)

load_regulation_source-o.table-s: Electrical Characteristics, Load Regulation dVO/VO, IL = 0.1 mA to 150 mA: 0.02 % typ, 0.2 % max (25 C), 0.5 % max bold (-40..125 C)
load_regulation_source-o.derived: 0.5 % x 2800 mV = 14 mV over 149.9 mA = 93.4 mV/A (worst case, the value klayout reads); 0.02 % -> 3.74 mV/A typ; 0.2 % -> 37.4 mV/A at 25 C

cout_source-o.table-s: Applications Information, Output Capacitor: 1.0 uF min without CBYP, 2.2 uF min with CBYP 470 pF; 'may be increased without limit'; ESR about 5 ohm or less, resonant frequency above 1 MHz; 0.47 uF below 10 mA, 0.33 uF below 1 mA

ilimit_source-o.table-s: Electrical Characteristics: ILIMIT 320 typ / 500 max mA, VOUT = 0 V

not_stated-o.output_impedance_mohm: not in the datasheet: no Zout plot. Micrel M9999-020806 Typical Characteristics p5-6 (rendered and read 2026-10-21): PSRR, ripple rejection vs voltage drop, turn-on time vs CBYP, dropout vs output current, noise; Microchip DS20005785B (2022, DS20005785B.pdf beside this record) Figures 2-1..2-18: the same set
not_stated-o.load_transient: not in the datasheet: no load- or line-transient figure. Micrel M9999-020806 Typical Characteristics p5-6 (rendered and read 2026-10-21): PSRR, ripple rejection vs voltage drop, turn-on time vs CBYP, dropout vs output current, noise; Microchip DS20005785B (2022, DS20005785B.pdf beside this record) Figures 2-1..2-18: the same set
not_stated-o.efficiency_pct: not plotted (LDO): input current = output current + ground current (IGND 0.6 mA typ at 100 mA, p3), so an output step appears unchanged at the input

source-o.table-s: Operating Ratings: Input Voltage (VIN) +2.5 V to +16 V (same in DS20005785B p3)
